title: Fiscal Progressivity and the Time Consistency of Monetary Policy
title_zh: 财政累进性与货币政策的时间一致性
title_primary: 财政累进性与货币政策的时间一致性
title_secondary: Fiscal Progressivity and the Time Consistency of Monetary Policy
authors: ANTOINE CAMOUS
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2026-07-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper studies how progressive fiscal policy shapes monetary policy in a heterogeneous‐agent economy. Progressive labor taxation, though distortionary, can mitigate the inflation bias of monetary policy by redistributing income. I examine this commitment channel through the lens of political conflict. When agents vote on monetary and fiscal instruments, progressivity curbs inflation bias by creating distributional tensions: lower productivity agents support higher labor taxes to protect the value of money holdings and shift tax distortions toward higher productivity agents. Anticipating lower inflation, all agents ultimately prefer adopting a progressive fiscal system.
abstract_zh: 本文研究累进性财政政策如何在异质性主体经济中塑造货币政策。尽管累进劳动税具有扭曲效应，但可通过收入再分配缓解货币政策的通胀偏差。本文通过政治冲突视角考察这一承诺渠道。当经济主体对货币与财政工具进行投票时，累进税制通过制造分配性张力抑制通胀偏差：低生产率主体支持提高劳动税以保护货币持有价值，并将税收扭曲转嫁给高生产率主体。由于预期通胀水平降低，所有经济主体最终都倾向于采用累进性财政体系。

title: Debt service and fiscal sustainability
title_zh: 债务服务与财政可持续性
title_primary: 债务服务与财政可持续性
title_secondary: Debt service and fiscal sustainability
authors: Barry Eichengreen, Maxime Menuet, Gregory Donnat
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Debt sustainability analysis typically focuses on debt stocks and the interest rate-growth rate differential, but these are not perfect predictors of fiscal stress. This column argues that debt-service costs are key to understanding when fiscal adjustments become necessary. Using long-run historical evidence, it shows that primary surpluses are more closely associated with debt-service costs than with debt ratios, and that fiscal responses intensify when financing conditions deteriorate. Overall, debt-service costs represent the immediate claim of public debt on government resources and therefore provide a more direct measure of fiscal pressure than debt ratios alone.
abstract_zh: 债务可持续性分析通常关注债务存量及利率与增长率之差，但这些指标并非财政压力的完美预测因子。本文认为，偿债成本是理解何时需要进行财政调整的关键。基于长期历史证据表明，基本盈余与偿债成本的关联性高于与债务比率的关联性，且当融资条件恶化时，财政应对措施会显著加强。总体而言，偿债成本代表了公共债务对政府资源的即时索取权，因此相较于单纯的债务比率，它能更直接地衡量财政压力。

title: DP743 Privatization, Risk-Taking, and the Communist Firm
title_zh: 私有化、风险承担与共产主义企业
title_primary: 私有化、风险承担与共产主义企业
title_secondary: DP743 Privatization, Risk-Taking, and the Communist Firm
authors: Hans-Wener Sinn, Dominique Demougin, Markus Behn, Stijn Claessens, Leonardo Gambacorta 等
official: 官方在线 1993-01-31 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper studies alternative methods of privatizing a formerly communist firm in the presence of imperfect risk markets. The methods include cash sales, a give-away scheme, and a participation contract where the government retains a sleeping fractional ownership in the firm. It is shown that with competitive bidding, the participation contract dominates cash sales because it generates both more private restructuring investment and a higher expected present value of revenue for the government. Under weak conditions the participation contract will induce more investment than the giveaway scheme, and it may even share the cash sales' virtue of incentive compatibility.
abstract_zh: 本文研究在不完全风险市场条件下，对前共产主义企业进行私有化的替代方案。这些方案包括现金出售、无偿分配计划，以及政府保留企业部分被动股权的参与合同。研究表明，在竞标机制下，参与合同优于现金出售，因为它既能促进更多私人重组投资，又能为政府带来更高的预期收入现值。在较弱条件下，参与合同比无偿分配计划更能激励投资，甚至可能兼具现金出售在激励相容性方面的优势。

title: The Great Depression as a Watershed: International Capital Mobility over the Long Run
title_zh: 大萧条作为分水岭：长期国际资本流动
title_primary: 大萧条作为分水岭：长期国际资本流动
title_secondary: The Great Depression as a Watershed: International Capital Mobility over the Long Run
authors: Maurice Obstfeld, Alan M. Taylor
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2007-10-24 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper surveys the evolution of international capital mobility since the late-nineteenth century. It begins with an overview of empirical evidence on the fall and rise of integration in the global capital market. A discussion of institutional developments focuses on the use of capital controls and the pursuit of domestic macroeconomic policy objectives in the context of changing monetary regimes. A fundamental macroeconomic policy trilemma has forced policy-makers to trade off conflicting goals. The natural implication of the trilemma is that capital mobility has prevailed and expanded under circumstances of widespread political support either for an exchange rate subordinated monetary policy regime (e.g. the gold standard), or for a monetary regime geared mainly towards domestic objectives at the expense of exchange rate stability (e.g. the recent float). Through its effect on popular attitudes towards both the gold standard and the legitimate scope for government macroeconomic intervention, the Great Depression emerges as the key turning point in the recent history of international capital markets.
abstract_zh: 本文梳理了自19世纪末以来国际资本流动性的演变历程。首先概述了全球资本市场一体化兴衰的实证证据。在制度发展讨论中，重点分析了资本管制手段的运用，以及不同货币制度背景下各国追求国内宏观经济政策目标的行为。一个根本性的宏观经济政策三难困境迫使决策者在相互冲突的目标间进行权衡。该三难困境的自然推论是：当汇率从属于货币政策（如金本位制）或货币政策主要服务于国内目标而牺牲汇率稳定（如近期浮动汇率制）获得广泛政治支持时，资本流动性便得以盛行并扩张。通过影响民众对金本位制及政府宏观经济干预合理范围的认知，大萧条成为国际资本市场近代史中的关键转折点。

title: Productivity-carbon trade-offs in Ghana: Quantifying the roles of irrigation and organic farming in land-use optimisation
title_zh: 加纳生产力-碳权衡：量化灌溉与有机农业在土地利用优化中的作用
title_primary: 加纳生产力-碳权衡：量化灌溉与有机农业在土地利用优化中的作用
title_secondary: Productivity-carbon trade-offs in Ghana: Quantifying the roles of irrigation and organic farming in land-use optimisation
authors: Kwaku Asuako Tabiri
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Agricultural expansion in Ghana continues to drive deforestation, posing a major challenge to balancing food production with forest carbon conservation. While Sustainable Agricultural Intensification (SAI) is widely promoted, its ecological and land use planning implications remain underexplored in policy contexts. This study investigates the trade-offs between agricultural intensification and forest carbon conservation, aiming to identify land use configurations that optimise both productivity and environmental sustainability within Ghana’s national planning framework. Using a 31-year FAOSTAT dataset, a socio-ecological systems approach integrating Random Forest and polynomial regression models was applied to capture non-linear dynamics. A multi-objective optimisation framework was used to derive Pareto-optimal land use allocations under empirical constraints, reflecting real-world policy and adoption limitations. Findings reveal that land use composition – particularly the cropland-pasture balance – has a stronger influence on forest carbon stocks than intensification alone. Low adoption rates of irrigation and organic farming limit their national impact. The optimal land use mix (58.85% cropland, 41.15% pasture, 1% organic, 3.01% irrigated) achieves 92% of a composite objective prioritising productivity (70%) and carbon conservation (30%). These results underscore the need for spatially differentiated land use policies that incorporate zoning, targeted incentives, and coordinated landscape governance. The study shows that the ecological impacts of intensification depend on its scale, type, and socio-ecological context. For policymakers, this highlights the need to move beyond uniform SAI approaches toward spatially targeted strategies that integrate land-use zoning, practice-specific incentives, and coordinated landscape management to balance agricultural productivity with forest conservation.
abstract_zh: 加纳农业扩张持续加剧森林砍伐，对平衡粮食生产与森林碳汇保护构成重大挑战。尽管可持续农业集约化（SAI）被广泛推广，但其生态影响及土地利用规划意义在政策语境中仍未得到充分探讨。本研究探究农业集约化与森林碳汇保护之间的权衡关系，旨在识别在国家规划框架内同时优化生产力与环境可持续性的土地利用配置方案。基于31年FAOSTAT数据集，采用整合随机森林与多项式回归模型的社会-生态系统方法捕捉非线性动态，并运用多目标优化框架在经验约束条件下推导帕累托最优土地利用分配方案，以反映现实政策与采纳限制。研究发现：土地利用构成（尤其是农田-牧场比例）对森林碳储量的影响强于集约化本身；灌溉与有机农业的低采纳率限制了其国家层面影响；最优土地利用组合（58.85%农田、41.15%牧场、1%有机农业、3.01%灌溉面积）可实现优先考虑生产力（70%）与碳汇保护（30%）的复合目标值的92%。这些结果凸显了制定空间差异化土地利用政策的必要性，需整合分区规划、定向激励与协调性景观治理。研究表明，集约化的生态影响取决于其规模、类型及社会-生态背景。对政策制定者而言，这要求超越统一的SAI方法，转向整合土地利用分区、实践导向激励与协调性景观管理的空间靶向策略，以平衡农业生产与森林保护。

authors: Kelli Marquardt, Conor Ryan
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-18 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper theoretically and empirically examines the role of information in pharmaceutical detailing (promotional interactions between drug representatives and physicians). We start with a theoretical framework in which pharmaceutical firms target detailing visits to physicians who learn about drug quality and prescribe accordingly. We derive several predictions about the role of information in these visits, which we then test empirically using prescriptions and pharmaceutical detailing visit data. We find limited empirical support of learning as the dominant mechanism, though cannot rule it out completely. We conclude with discussing alternative models that may be more consistent with the observed empirical patterns.
abstract_zh: 本文从理论与实证角度探讨信息在药品推广拜访（即医药代表与医生之间的促销互动）中的作用。我们首先构建了一个理论框架，其中制药企业针对医生进行定向推广拜访，医生通过此类拜访了解药品质量并据此开具处方。基于此框架，我们推导出关于信息在推广拜访中作用的若干预测，并利用处方数据与药品推广拜访数据进行了实证检验。研究发现，学习机制作为主导解释的实证支持有限，但无法完全排除其可能性。最后，我们讨论了与观察到的实证模式更为一致的替代模型。

title: Unwilling to Reskill? Experimental Evidence from Real-World Jobseekers
title_zh: 不愿再培训？来自真实求职者的实验证据
title_primary: 不愿再培训？来自真实求职者的实验证据
title_secondary: Unwilling to Reskill? Experimental Evidence from Real-World Jobseekers
authors: Alexia Delfino, Andrea Garnero, Sergio Inferrera, Marco Leonardi, Raffaella Sadun 等
official: 官方在线 2026-01-19 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study barriers preventing jobseekers from pursuing reskilling in high-demand occupations. Using a discrete choice experiment, we quantify the demand for reskilling among Italian jobseekers in two white-collar high-demand occupations—information technology assistant and construction technician—and identify its main determinants. Willingness to pay estimates show that participants are willing to pay to reskill into IT, but would require compensation to reskill into construction. Beliefs about monetary returns and social status help explain differences in reskilling demand, but perceived identity fit in the target occupation emerges as the most important individual-level factor shaping reskilling decisions. A light-touch randomized information intervention providing data on occupational returns significantly increases both stated interest in reskilling and actual engagement in real- world training.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了阻碍求职者向高需求职业进行技能再培训的障碍。通过一项离散选择实验，我们量化了意大利求职者对两种白领高需求职业——信息技术助理和建筑技术员——的技能再培训需求，并识别了其主要决定因素。支付意愿估计显示，参与者愿意为转向信息技术领域支付费用，但转向建筑领域则需要补偿。对货币回报和社会地位的信念有助于解释技能再培训需求的差异，但目标职业中的感知身份契合度成为影响技能再培训决策的最重要的个体层面因素。一项提供职业回报数据的轻触式随机信息干预显著提高了对技能再培训的表态兴趣以及实际参与现实世界培训的积极性。

title: Does competition drive the sustainability and financial performance of firms? Evidence from G-20 nations
title_zh: 竞争是否驱动企业的可持续性与财务绩效？来自G20国家的证据
title_primary: 竞争是否驱动企业的可持续性与财务绩效？来自G20国家的证据
title_secondary: Does competition drive the sustainability and financial performance of firms? Evidence from G-20 nations
authors: Rajesh Bhue Ajaya Kumar Panda Mainak Mazumdar a Finance and Economics, Indian Institute of Management, Mumbai, Indiab Accounting and Finance, Indiac Economics and Strategy, India
official: 官方在线 2025-08-16 · 来源：RSS
abstract: To preserve a competitive edge and protect proprietary information, companies may strategically design their ESG disclosures in line with product market competition (PMC). This study aims to examine how the moderating role of PMC influences the relationship between sustainable practices and ‘firm financial performance’ (FFP). Using regression techniques on a sample of 2801 firms from G-20 countries over a study period covering from 2011 to 2023, findings show that firms’ sustainable practices positively impact FFP. PMC effectively acts as a disciplinary mechanism for firm’s performance and aligns with the deterrence hypothesis. Due to competitive pressure, sustainable practices increase firm performance. Although in all cases, PMC does not portray moderating effect to establish relationship between sustainable practices and firm value, the individual parameters, such as environmental and social practices, are enhancing FFP under high PMC levels. While in low competition, environmental practices detriment FFP due to competitive disadvantages. Further, in developed countries, PMC is ineffective, whereas it effectively works for developing countries. Using alternative competition measures, sensitivity analysis, and propensity score matching, the present study provides robust empirical evidence to validate the moderating role of PMC in shaping ESG-FFP dynamics. Managers may leverage PMC strategically; investors and policymakers ought to keep on surveillance for greenwashing.
abstract_zh: 为保持竞争优势并保护专有信息，企业可能根据产品市场竞争（PMC）策略性地设计其ESG披露。本研究旨在探讨PMC的调节作用如何影响可持续实践与企业财务绩效（FFP）之间的关系。基于2011至2023年间G20国家2801家企业的样本数据，采用回归分析发现：企业可持续实践对FFP具有正向影响。PMC有效发挥企业绩效的惩戒机制作用，与威慑假说一致。在竞争压力下，可持续实践提升了企业绩效。尽管在所有情形中PMC均未表现出调节可持续实践与企业价值关系的效应，但在高PMC水平下，环境与社会实践等单项指标均能提升FFP；而在低竞争环境下，环境实践因竞争劣势反而损害FFP。此外，PMC在发达国家中调节效应不显著，但在发展中国家表现有效。通过采用替代竞争指标、敏感性分析和倾向得分匹配，本研究为PMC在ESG-FFP动态关系中的调节作用提供了稳健的实证证据。管理者可策略性运用PMC；投资者与政策制定者需持续警惕漂绿行为。
